correctness.rationale: Every proper subset has an exact lower support value from contained cyclic tubes. Decomposing selected and complementary sets into equal numbers of cyclic runs gives a positive nondecreasing deficit function f; the directed support quotients are globally bounded by f(n−1)/f(1) and attained at each co-singleton. The full subset-inequality representation of the Minkowski sum is reconstructed by sorted-coordinate separation. Averaging feasible centers under cyclic rotations proves global optimality, and the co-singleton equality hyperplanes force all coordinates of any optimum to be equal. Filtration and symmetry corollaries follow by exact algebra. Independent exact-rational checker passed 770 finite profiles; this is corroboration not a general proof.

value.rationale: This determines the complete affine-invariant reflection-geometry profile for an infinite length-weighted family containing all cycle m-graph stages and their terminal cyclohedron, not merely a scalar for one polytope. Its exact center uniqueness and explicit half-unit rise with an exceptional last increment expose a structural transition through the natural zonotope-to-cyclohedron interpolation. Central symmetry is also classified by the length distribution. These are meaningful properties of the original graph-polytope filtration rather than arbitrary slices or a table lookup.
